acceptance: Examples use supported manager create with input-only operands and the exact template version; they do not author admission manifests or replace owner APIs.

Monitoring is read-only; query time is not worker contact; unknown activity is not success; ending the monitor does not stop scheduling.

Verify all documented command examples against current supported parsers and behavior. Preserve the historical instance4 QUICKSTART facts; do not claim source features are installed there. Deliver documentation, not product redesign.
